Protocols / Phenotyping & imaging

Measuring cell aspect ratio

Phenotyping & imagingBy Various authorsVersion 1 · updated 2026-10-07

Calcofluor White staining and ×40 imaging for Cellpose-based cell shape measurements.

Download (.docx) PDF

Adapted from the lab compendium Snowflake Yeast Protocols — Ratcliff Lab / MuLTEE (V2).

  1. Follow the 5-day re-acclimation protocol (Culturing & settling selection › Daily growth and settling selection and Freezer stocks › Reviving strains from frozen stock).
  2. On the final day, transfer 100 μL of culture into fresh YPD and incubate for 12 h.
  3. Stain with Calcofluor White (5 μM final), 30 min in the dark.
  4. Image at ×40 objective, UV excitation of the blue fluorescent cell wall stain (Nikon Ti-E system).

Image analysis pipeline (cell segmentation): zipped folder containing pipeline is attached — Cellpose-based segmentation of individual cells, measures aspect ratio (AR) directly along with area, major/minor axis, circularity, and solidity.
